header.title_en: Grade III · General Knowledge · End-of-chapter paper
header.title_ur: جماعت سوم · واقفیتِ عامہ · باب کے اختتام کا پرچہ

slots.prompt_rule: Five three-option MCQs on the chapter's facts, in short plain Urdu a Grade III child reads alone. From the chosen chapter only, on everyday general knowledge (our country, our city, family and community, health and safety, plants and animals, Earth and sky): no religious content, no Hamd, Naat, Quran or Hadith. One option right; no item gives away another item's answer. One idea is tested once across the MCQ, blank, short and long items. Two options never both fit the stem.

slots.instruction_ur: کالم الف کو کالم ب سے ملائیں۔ درست حرف خالی جگہ میں لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Five pairs from the chapter: a thing, place or person in column A and what it is, does or belongs to in column B, each side one or two Urdu words. From the chosen chapter only, on everyday general knowledge (our country, our city, family and community, health and safety, plants and animals, Earth and sky): no religious content, no Hamd, Naat, Quran or Hadith. Every column-B entry matches exactly one column-A entry, and gives the chapter's own meaning of the word, not a loose paraphrase. No two column-A entries are near in meaning (not «دوسروں کی بات» beside «دوسروں کی رائے»): read each column-A entry against every column-B entry before keeping it; a column-A entry two column-B entries fit is replaced.

slots.instruction_ur: خالی جگہ دیے گئے الفاظ سے پُر کریں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Ten one-line facts from the chapter with one blank each; the ten answers plus ONE spare word, mixed, in "words" on the FIRST item (eleven words: the spare is a chapter word of the same kind that fits no blank, so the last blank is never free). From the chosen chapter only, on everyday general knowledge (our country, our city, family and community, health and safety, plants and animals, Earth and sky): no religious content, no Hamd, Naat, Quran or Hadith. Each answer is a single Urdu word the chapter uses. Each blank takes exactly one of the box words and no other box word fits it. A box word is never a Q4 or Q5 answer point. Read each blank against every box word before keeping it; a blank two box words fit is rewritten.

slots.instruction_ur: کوئی سے پانچ سوالوں کے جواب لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Seven short-answer questions on the chapter (name, what is, where, why, how many), each one short Urdu line. From the chosen chapter only, on everyday general knowledge (our country, our city, family and community, health and safety, plants and animals, Earth and sky): no religious content, no Hamd, Naat, Quran or Hadith. Answer: one or two short Urdu sentences. Scheme: K 1 per correct idea, three ideas for 3. Marks match the ask: one definition is one point, never three. No point pays for a clear or full sentence. A "when" key names the moment or cause the chapter gives, never a means such as effort, and two questions on one idea carry keys that agree. No key point is printed on the paper as an MCQ key or option, a match pair, or a blank sentence or box word.

slots.instruction_ur: کوئی سے دو سوالوں کے تفصیلی جواب لکھیں۔
slots.prompt_rule: Three questions that ask the child to describe, explain or give uses or reasons from the chapter in a few sentences (how we keep clean, why plants matter, what our city has). No religious content: Islamiat is a separate subject, so no Quran, Hadith, Hamd, Naat or Islamiat item here. Answer: a model of 4 to 5 short Urdu sentences. Scheme (5): K 1 per correct point up to 4, L 1 for clear order. No key point is printed on the paper as an MCQ key or option, a match pair, or a blank sentence or box word. A long question never asks for the facts or examples a short question asks.

lines_en: One mark per correct item unless the paper says otherwise. Spelling is not marked unless the key says so.
lines_ur: جب تک پرچے میں کچھ اور نہ لکھا ہو، ہر درست جواب پر 1 نمبر۔ املا کے نمبر صرف وہاں کٹتے ہیں جہاں کلید میں لکھا ہو۔

Mark question by question across all copies, not copy by copy.
